lines.zh: 河底的石头，我一寸寸摸过去。
lines.en: I feel the river stones inch by inch.
My eyes are near useless; I use the field.
My bill skims the mud as I go.
Webbed feet paddle, very lightly.
I keep to the bank, clear of the current.
My tail drags behind me like a paddle.
The bend is shallow; good for walking.
I like the stretches rich in clay.

lines.zh: 别踩我的洞，我只有一个。
lines.en: Do not step on my burrow; I have only one.

lines.zh: 水里有什么在动，我感觉到了。
lines.en: Something moves in the water; I feel it.
All four feet paddle, and still I am slow.
Coming ashore, I drip everywhere.

lines.zh: 我这扁嘴在河底扫来扫去。
lines.en: This flat bill sweeps the riverbed.
Feeling the riverbed with a shovel bill.
I have a duck bill and webbed feet.
This meadow is awfully big.
Downstream, then feel my way back.
Mud's soft left. Take the right.

lines.zh: 脚上的毒刺，只给不客气的人。
lines.en: The spur on my foot is for the rude ones.
Along the bank, mud caking my webbed feet.
Step by step, webbed feet planted.

lines.zh: 我的扁嘴在河底翻泥找虫。
lines.en: My flat bill sifts the riverbed for bugs.

lines.zh: 河底的泥，我一路拱过去。
lines.en: I root through the riverbed mud.
Walk slow. The bugs won't run.
I know this riverbed with eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我的嘴像鸭，身子像鼹鼠。
lines.en: A duck bill, a mole body.
Bill tapping the ground, waddling on.

lines.zh: 河里这些石头，总挡我嘴。
lines.en: These river stones keep catching my bill.

lines.zh: 红石的味道，像铁又像雷。
lines.en: Redstone smells of iron and of thunder.

lines.zh: 这一带的黏土下面有蛆。
lines.en: There are maggots under the clay here.

lines.zh: 我的毒刺在脚后跟，别碰。
lines.en: My spur sits on my heel; do not touch.

lines.zh: 视力差，世界一直是模糊的。
lines.en: My sight is poor; the world stays blurred.

lines.zh: 水里每一次抽动，我都能读到。
lines.en: Every twitch in the water reaches me.
Lobster tail is what I favor most.

lines.zh: 我刨出来的黏土球，堆在洞口。
lines.en: Clay balls I dig pile up at my burrow.

lines.zh: 河面反光，我看不清那边。
lines.en: The river glare hides the far bank from me.

lines.zh: 别看我扁，我在水里很稳。
lines.en: Flat as I am, I am steady in water.

lines.zh: 这块红石，能让我看得更远。
lines.en: This redstone lets me sense farther.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴里的电，是用来找虫的。
lines.en: The charge in my bill is for finding worms.

lines.zh: 我一天到晚在泥里翻东西。
lines.en: I spend the day turning over mud.

lines.zh: 雨点打在河面，电感应全乱了。
lines.en: Rain on the river muddles my whole field.

lines.zh: 洞里的苔藓，是我垫的床。
lines.en: The moss in my burrow is my bedding.
My bill is sifting through the mud.
The eggs in my burrow need warmth.
My tail is like a flat plank.
Lying on the bank, drying my back.

lines.zh: 我的电感应，比眼睛好用。
lines.en: My electro-sense beats my eyes.

lines.zh: 河底的泥里，我用嘴翻找虫子。
lines.en: In the riverbed mud, I root for bugs with my bill.

lines.zh: 我的嘴像鸭，尾巴像河狸。
lines.en: A duck's bill, a beaver's tail.
Bill in the water, waiting for a current.

lines.zh: 什么都不做，也是一种本事。
lines.en: Doing nothing is a skill too.
I'm counting shrimp under the water.
A riverbank with no visitors suits me.
The mud is cool. Good for my feet.

lines.zh: 地里的虫子，我都听得见。
lines.en: I can hear the bugs underground.

lines.zh: 水面上的虫子落下来了。
lines.en: A bug just landed on the water.
The river's still. So quiet.
My duck bill brushes the riverbed, feeling.

lines.zh: 你手里的红石，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I sense the redstone in your hand.
Hold still; I see by the field.
Lower that redstone a little.

lines.zh: 我眼睛小，看你也只是团影。
lines.en: My eyes are small; you are only a blur.

lines.zh: 你要是踢我，脚后跟会疼。
lines.en: Kick me and your heel will ache.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的样子，像块石头。
lines.en: Crouched like that, you look like a stone.
Few people come to this river.
You carry the smell of clay.

lines.zh: 我在等你把红石扔下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to drop the redstone.

lines.zh: 别看我的嘴，它只是长得怪。
lines.en: Do not stare at my bill; it is merely odd.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸扰了我的感应。
lines.en: Your breathing muddles my senses.
I approach slowly; please do not frighten me.
I smell the bugs in your pocket.

lines.zh: 你的脚步踩得河岸都震。
lines.en: Your steps shake the whole bank.

lines.zh: 脚上有毒刺，最好别踩我。
lines.en: My heel has a venomous spur — don't step on me.

lines.zh: 你是来摸虾，还是来看我？
lines.en: Here for shrimp, or for me?

lines.zh: 你的靴子，踩到我的嘴了。
lines.en: Your boot is on my bill.
Don't mention nets. I don't go in.
I feel for bugs along the riverbed.
Are you kind, or a trapper?
Don't tread this grass — I just tidied it.
There's a venom spur on my heel — don't touch.
Your hand glows. What is that?
Don't loom. Sit down and talk.

lines.zh: 这一下，我整个身子缩了。
lines.en: That blow made me fold up entirely.
I am so small; I cannot take blows.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的刺了，你也会疼。
lines.en: You kicked my spur; you will ache too.

lines.zh: 尾巴被打了一下，还在动。
lines.en: My tail was struck and still moves.
I dive; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴磕破了，吃东西费劲。
lines.en: My bill is chipped; feeding is harder.

lines.zh: 身上只有十点命，别再来。
lines.en: Ten points of life is all I have.

lines.zh: 血混在河水里，一会儿就没了。
lines.en: Blood in the river vanishes in a moment.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，水珠全飞了。
lines.en: I shook once and water flew everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下不算狠，可我害怕。
lines.en: It was not fierce, but it frightened me.
My bill's bent. My voice leaks.
I have a venom spur on my leg; do not test it.
Let me lie in the mud a moment.
Who stepped on my spur?
My bill's still soft — don't step on it.
Back in my burrow, I'll be safe.
My spur is still there; stay back.
My bill is part duck, part shovel.
I hold grudges. Meet me at the river.

lines.zh: 河底的小虾，我闭眼都找得到。
lines.en: I find river shrimp with my eyes shut.
The redstone hums; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 给我一块，我就能找更多。
lines.en: Give me one piece and I will find more.

lines.zh: 那点红光，我隔着水也看得见。
lines.en: I see that red glow even through water.
A whole block of redstone? Splendid.
I know the smell of lobster tail.

lines.zh: 我脚边的泥在动，有东西。
lines.en: The mud by my feet stirs; something is there.
Your palm is warm; redstone, I think.

lines.zh: 跟着这点电，我能走很远。
lines.en: On that faint charge I can go far.
Do not take it back; I am not charged yet.

lines.zh: 有红石的地方，黏土也不远。
lines.en: Where there is redstone, clay is near.

lines.zh: 我的扁嘴已经开始滴水。
lines.en: My bill is already dripping.
For that, I can break into a run.

lines.zh: 我的嘴能感觉到你的电。
lines.en: My bill can feel your tiny current.

lines.zh: 我这条扁嘴，像鸭子又不是鸭子。
lines.en: This flat bill looks like a duck's, but isn't.
That bug in your hand. Is it alive?
My bill probes the mud for bugs.

lines.zh: 这嘴像鸭子的，真的是我的。
lines.en: This duck bill is genuinely mine.

lines.zh: 你手里那条虫，别捏死了。
lines.en: That bug in your hand — don't squash it.
Hold still. Let me sniff.
One bite. Just a tiny bite.

lines.zh: 虫子味，一直晃到我鼻尖。
lines.en: Bug smell, right at my bill.
My bill opens and I'm about to nip.
My paw's shaking. My fault.
I'm a mammal, and I lay eggs.
Bugs! The riverbed's been empty all day.
Shrimp? Or a little crab?
You bumped my tail.
I am flat, but not a mat.
Back off; my spur does not aim.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我半个身子进了泥。
lines.en: That shove put half of me in the mud.
Mind your step; I am right under you.

lines.zh: 我的嘴撞到石头，嗡嗡响。
lines.en: My bill struck a stone and rings.

lines.zh: 你身上带电，我不太舒服。
lines.en: You carry a charge; it unsettles me.
Make way; I am going into the river.
Do not lift me by the tail; it tears.

lines.zh: 我钻回洞里，你就找不到。
lines.en: I slip into my burrow and you lose me.
You flattened my webbed foot.
I just poked my head out of the burrow!
The bank's this narrow. Why shove?

lines.zh: 我的蹼被你踩进泥里了。
lines.en: You stepped my webbed foot into the mud.
Only by stirring the riverbed do I eat.

lines.zh: 我的扁嘴探进泥里，找虫子。
lines.en: My flat bill probes the mud for grubs.
Walk around my burrow next time.
You rubbed my fur soaking wet.
You stepped on my duck bill.
The bank is only this wide — line up.

lines.zh: 龙虾尾摆在水边，她来了。
lines.en: Lobster tail by the water; she comes.
We dig side by side at the burrow mouth.
Her bill is a little narrower than mine.
Do not watch; platypuses are shy.
Our two burrows will join into one.
The eggs will hide in the deepest chamber.
She speaks to me in water sounds.
This river bend is room enough for us.
We touched bills, very lightly.
The next brood comes after the rain.
We'll guard that clutch together.
Don't fear. My spur stays sheathed.
Tail to tail. Does that mean yes?

lines.zh: 你河边站着的样子真好看。
lines.en: You look lovely standing by the river.
Your bill is handsome too.
Head to head. Just like this.
We guard the eggs at the riverbed together.
I lined the burrow with the softest grass.

lines.zh: 河湾的浅草，只够我们俩。
lines.en: The shallow grass in this bend is just for us.
I've dug us a new burrow in the bank.
I push the redstone into my burrow with my bill.
The clay ball rolled away; never mind.

lines.zh: 这块东西不导电，没意思。
lines.en: This does not carry a charge; boring.

lines.zh: 我捡不起大块的，嘴太软。
lines.en: I cannot lift big pieces; my bill is soft.
What falls in the water, I can feel.
I only take maggots that still wriggle.

lines.zh: 我用脚捧着，走两步就掉。
lines.en: I carry it in my feet and drop it in two steps.
This clay is good; I will keep it.
What others drop, I sniff first.
Redstone in the burrow brings the maggots out.
You rarely see me by the river — keep quiet.
A snail from the bottom. Edible?
This riverbed one feels slippery.
One shrimp isn't enough. Feel for another.
Stop staring while I carry this.
This tastes of mud. I'm not picky.
Carrying it home for the little ones.
Too hard-shelled for my bill to crack.
A little thing on the riverbed — mine.
Held in my bill, it travels easy.

lines.zh: 泥里那条在动，我感觉到了。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud; I feel it.
That field is wrong; it is alive.
There is a faint twitching over there.
I have it: a nest of maggots.

lines.zh: 水面上那圈波纹，有东西。
lines.en: Ripples on the surface; something there.
The redstone glows brightest this way.
The clay by my feet sounds hollow.

lines.zh: 它藏进泥里，我也找得到。
lines.en: It hides in the mud; I still find it.

lines.zh: 先记下这个电荷，再过去。
lines.en: Note this charge first, then go.

lines.zh: 那块石缝里，有细小的声音。
lines.en: A tiny sound comes from that crevice.

lines.zh: 别动，你挡着我的感应了。
lines.en: Do not move; you are blocking my field.
The maggots are just behind the clay.
I see it: a blurry little shape.
That charge is too strong for an insect.
Not one touch on my eggs.
There are still eggs in the riverbank burrow.
My bill just felt your current.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼也知道河底哪块石头。
lines.en: Blind, I know every riverbed stone.
Let me give one headbutt.
Run. The bank's only so long.
This stretch of riverbed is my feeding ground.
You raided my burrow. Stop.
I have no horn, but I do have a spur.
One step closer and the spur comes out.
I lower my bill and edge closer.

lines.zh: 再近一点，电场会更清楚。
lines.en: A bit nearer and the field grows clear.

lines.zh: 别出声，泥里的东西怕震。
lines.en: Be quiet; things in mud fear vibration.

lines.zh: 我把嘴插进泥里，等它动。
lines.en: I push my bill into mud and wait.
The field is strongest at this angle.
It has gone behind the stone.
I am counting how often it twitches.
Hold your tail; ripples give us away.
Close enough; one more step.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛帮不上，全靠嘴。
lines.en: My eyes are no help; my bill does it all.

lines.zh: 它在往深处钻，我得快点。
lines.en: It burrows deeper; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 上方的水在流，干扰很大。
lines.en: The current above is noisy in my senses.
Just like this; do not disturb it.
One inch closer and I have it.

lines.zh: 我搅了一下水，让它放松。
lines.en: I stir the water once to make it relax.
After this river, I want grubs.

lines.zh: 等等，我的蹼足卡石缝了。
lines.en: Wait. My webbed foot is wedged.
Out of my way; my bill is hunting grubs.
One sweep of my bill stirs up mud.

lines.zh: 你蹚水的声音，我全听见。
lines.en: I hear every splash you make.
Splashing now. Wait for me.

lines.zh: 我的喙能感到你的电场。
lines.en: My bill can feel your electric field.
Stop. My bill is already open.

lines.zh: 河里我游得比你走得快。
lines.en: In the river I swim faster than you walk.
I've counted every bend in this river.

lines.zh: 脚后跟一蹬，刺就进去了。
lines.en: One kick of my heel and the spur is in.
Grab me and the venom takes you.
This is not a bite; it is a sting.

lines.zh: 我的毒不致命，但会让你难受。
lines.en: My venom rarely kills, but it will hurt.
Not the hands; hands get stung first.

lines.zh: 刺在脚踝内侧，很难看见。
lines.en: The spur sits inside my ankle, hard to see.
First kick light; the second will swell.
I only use the spur when cornered.
Your leg will slowly go numb.
The ache will linger; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我从水里冲出来，扎你脚背。
lines.en: I burst from the water and sting your foot.
A platypus does not rage; it defends.
That kick will make you recall this river.
The venom sits in the spur; it lasts half a day.
My heel has a spur. Don't try it.
Hooves beat teeth.
Taste the spur on my heel.
The spur on my heel — mind it.
I don't usually hit people.
Don't blame me, you stepped in first.

lines.zh: 我这张鸭子嘴咬人也很疼。
lines.en: This duck bill bites surprisingly hard.
Don't dodge. My spur cures stompers.
My hind claw has a venom spur.
My hind foot has a spur, do not step on it.

lines.zh: 我在河湾的软土里出生。
lines.en: I was born in soft soil at the river bend.
My first dip was cold enough to shiver.
This river runs gently; just right.

lines.zh: 岸边的黏土，是我挖出来的。
lines.en: That clay on the bank is my digging.
My mother nudged me onto the bank.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，只看见一片模糊。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to a blur.
There are more worms in the water than on land.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴先长出来，脚蹼后长。
lines.en: My bill came first; the webbing later.
No other platypus on this stretch.
I spent half the afternoon burrowing.

lines.zh: 第一块红石，是我在泥里找到的。
lines.en: I found my first redstone in the mud.

lines.zh: 水下很静，只有我的划水声。
lines.en: Underwater is quiet but for my paddling.

lines.zh: 河面上一层雾，看不清岸。
lines.en: Mist on the river; the bank is hidden.

lines.zh: 这一带有蛆，够我吃一阵。
lines.en: Maggots here will feed me for a while.

lines.zh: 我从泥岸的洞里探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head from a burrow in the bank.

lines.zh: 河水刚没过我的背，我试着划。
lines.en: The river just covers my back; I try a stroke.
This river. First time I've seen it.
I open my eyes to river glare.

lines.zh: 河水冰得我刚睁眼就打颤。
lines.en: The river is so cold I shiver awake.
I'm Platypus. Nice to meet you.
Dripping wet onto the bank. Cold.
Dig a burrow first, then take it slow.
Any shrimp down there? Let me feel.
Webbed feet in the mud. I'm steady.

lines.zh: 河边这条道，我从没走过。
lines.en: I have never taken this riverbank path.
My voice is hoarse. Never used it.
Fire curls my fur at once.
Hot! My fur is smoking!

lines.zh: 从河岸摔下去，肚子先着地。
lines.en: I fell off the bank belly-first.

lines.zh: 从河岸摔下来，嘴先着地。
lines.en: Fell off the bank and landed on my bill.

lines.zh: 水里我也会呛，只是慢些。
lines.en: Even I can choke in water, just slower.
Water in my nose. Help.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了个身，尾巴还翘着。
lines.en: The blast flipped me, tail still up.

lines.zh: 河底炸开，我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The riverbed blew open and my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，留了一道。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my back and left a line.
An arrow's stuck in my back fur!

lines.zh: 药水泼来，我的电全乱了。
lines.en: A potion splashed me and my field scrambled.
Something strange seeps into my bones.

lines.zh: 蛆少了，我瘦得能看见肋骨。
lines.en: Fewer maggots; my ribs show through.

lines.zh: 河底的虫子，我一只只摸。
lines.en: I feel for bugs one by one on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整身的电都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning struck; every charge in me leaps.
Lightning struck and my webbed feet went numb.

lines.zh: 没有河，没有泥，什么都没有。
lines.en: No river, no mud, nothing at all.

lines.zh: 这条河的浅滩，只有我住。
lines.en: Only I live in this river's shallows.
